notes: REDACTION BOUNDARY: raw secret values never leave the producing attempt. The scanner runs with redaction enabled; any unredacted intermediate lives only in an attempt-private directory that is never published, never indexed by 02-evidence-index and never readable by a persona cell.
The only published artifacts are the redacted inventory and the redaction receipt. Logs pass the same redactor before retention.
Inventory entries are location fingerprints (path, line span, rule id, data-class label); no hash of an individual secret value is published because low-entropy values are brute-forceable.
No decrypt, crack, validity probe or credential use: a listed key store is a file-presence fact.

match_basis is a closed enum (purl, cpe) recorded per match with the identity of the database that produced it; CVE/GHSA aliases are collapsed so one advisory from both sources is one match with two citations

DECIDED (M5): every component no source covers is an explicit coverage-gap record with a closed reason; the threat workbench receives matches plus an aggregated gap summary (counts by ecosystem and reason; per-component list by reference)
the known-vulnerability database is a third-party aggregation that is pinned and hashed but not authored here; licence and attribution terms of the bundled data are reviewed before V11 ships
